liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Far From Me** (1 review): Passionate rendition of Far From Me is highlighted in the first set [29]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): The Cassidy performance is described as absolutely velvet on this recording [24]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Eyes was smooth, with Jerry looking at Brent while playing off each other [23]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Looks Like Rain is incredible, featuring thunder sound effects never heard before [27]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Second set gains energy with a jam sequence starting with Crazy Fingers [20]
- Feel Like A Stranger is well-jammed, and Far From Me is especially noted [21]

## The recordings

- **gd90-06-23.sbd.ladner.28690.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 170 min; rated 4.74/5 by 34 [1]. Said about its sound: Very nice sound on the recording, considered one of the best sounding 90 shows; Killer recording captures the thick bass-heavy sound of that summer [24][25]
- **gd1990-06-23.aud.ladner.10261.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 171 min; rated 3/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience noise is audible, and the overall sound is described as a bit flat [20]
- **gd1990-06-23.163867.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 21 songs; 170 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [9]
- **gd1990-06-23.akg-nak.miller.99648.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 168 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [18]

## Around the show

- Town was hospitable, stadium not too cavernous, and crowd loved every minute [22]
- Bill Graham handed out garbage bags, and Ken Kesey played Thunder Machine [30]
- Beautiful sunny Oregon afternoon with the only Playing>UJB>Playing the reviewer saw [30]
- Largest venue the reviewer ever saw the band in, with a party afterwards [31]
- Eugene shows encapsulate the band's peak powers during the year 1990 [21]
- Looser and more vibe-focused than the technical prowess displayed that spring [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd90-06-23.sbd.ladner.28690.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD-matrix>CM>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN - see info file for more details. Upgrade over previous SBD source. [1]
- **gd1990-06-23.aud.ladner.10261.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>Cm>Dat>Samplitude>CD. Seeded by Charlie Miller via Neo_Levo to candyman and abgd. [6]. Also: Likely Healy Matrix source from the June 1990 West Coast tour [20]
- **gd1990-06-23.163867.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D6 [9]. Also: Ted Mattes supplied a Schoeps CMC4 MK21 source patching a 0:10 gap in Uncle John's Band [9]
- **gd1990-06-23.akg-nak.miller.99648.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Charlie Miller; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 100/CP4 + AKG C1000S -> Boss BX-4 -> Cassette Master (Sony WM-D6C) -> Cassette [18]. Also: Sennheiser ME-80 to DAT to FLAC supplies a patch for Uncle John's Band; Recorded front row center, mic stand about 8-9 feet high; masters lost, poor transfer used [18]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by gocollect.com: [Grateful Dead & Little Feat Autzen Stadium Fan Art 1990 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/grateful-dead-autzen-stadium-1990) [33]
- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [1990-06-23 Autzen Stadium, U. of Oregon, Eugene, OR, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1990-06-23-autzen-stadium-u-of-oregon-eugene-or-usa/) [34]
- Fan art by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks, Volume 44 (Autzen Stadium, U. Of Oregon, Eugene, OR 6/23/90) - Sealed 2022 US 3-CD set](https://uk.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-44-autzen-stadium-u-of-oregon-eugene-or-6-23-90-sealed-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2677184-847515) [35]
